critical_code_review_comments: TemplateEditor useEffect only depends on [value]; if `mode` changes but value stays identical this is fine, but consider also depending on `mode` if language switch ever mattered. Not a bug currently.
The `active === p[keyName]` comparison in Presets uses full-string equality against the current editor value; after any manual edit no preset shows active, which is expected UX.
context_for_next_testing_agent: TemplateEditor imperative sync via view.dispatch on value prop change is confirmed working. Selector pattern for CodeMirror content: '[data-testid="simple-template"] .cm-content' (use keyboard.type not fill). Read text via .cm-content innerText.
rca of the issue: Previously CodeMirror was uncontrolled after first user input because @uiw/react-codemirror only syncs `value` on initial mount / when no user edits happened. Fix in TemplateEditor.jsx uses useRef+useEffect([value]) to dispatch a full-doc replace transaction when the external value diverges from view.state.doc — verified via type-then-preset test on both tabs.
